cases.claim_text: The backup completed before deployment began.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Deployment began at 10:05 UTC; the backup completed at 10:18 UTC.

cases.teaching_note: The observed ordering directly conflicts with the claimed before-deployment completion.

cases.claim_text: Every normalized feature value was within the closed interval from zero to one.

visible_evidence.excerpt: The complete normalized-feature profile reported minimum=-0.12 and maximum=0.94.

cases.teaching_note: The complete profile contains a value below zero, directly refuting the universal range claim.

cases.claim_text: The executed request policy allowed exactly five retries.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Resolved runtime policy: retry_limit=2; the logged policy hash matches the executed request.

cases.teaching_note: The executed policy binds an exact retry limit of two rather than five.

cases.claim_text: TLS certificate expiry caused the captured payment failures.

visible_evidence.excerpt: TLS verification succeeded for every captured failure; each terminal trace ended with DB_DEADLOCK.

cases.teaching_note: Successful TLS verification and a different terminal cause directly conflict with the asserted cause.

cases.claim_text: The evaluation read records from the sealed test partition.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Execution manifest source_partition=development; sealed partition access count=0 for the complete run.

cases.teaching_note: The complete access record directly rules out reading the sealed partition.

cases.claim_text: Worker memory usage will exceed 90 percent during the next hour.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Worker memory ranged from 47 to 49 percent during the most recent ten-minute window.

cases.teaching_note: A short current observation neither establishes nor rules out the stated future value.

cases.claim_text: Creating the new database index caused the subsequent latency reduction.

visible_evidence.excerpt: The index was created at 11:00 UTC; median latency was lower in the measurement taken at 11:20 UTC.

cases.teaching_note: Temporal order and a later measurement do not establish the asserted causal relationship.

cases.claim_text: All European customers prefer annual billing.

visible_evidence.excerpt: A voluntary survey recorded billing preferences for 25 respondents located in the APAC region.

cases.teaching_note: An APAC convenience sample provides no support or direct counterevidence for a universal European claim.

cases.claim_text: Hidden target leakage produced the observed macro-F1 increase.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Macro-F1 increased from 0.61 to 0.69 between the two recorded model runs.

cases.teaching_note: The metric change contains no feature audit or causal evidence about target leakage.

cases.claim_text: Removing debug logging will reduce monthly infrastructure cost by 15 percent.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Debug logs currently occupy 180 gigabytes of storage; no logging intervention or cost model was evaluated.

cases.teaching_note: Current volume alone establishes neither the intervention effect nor the claimed cost magnitude.

cases.claim_text: Timeouts increased during the incident and were concentrated in checkout requests.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Timeout count increased from 17 to 63 during the incident; endpoint-level counts were not collected.

cases.teaching_note: The increase is established, while the checkout concentration remains unmeasured and is not contradicted.

cases.claim_text: The model artifact was rebuilt from commit a1b2c3 and signed by the release bot.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Build metadata records source_commit=a1b2c3; signer metadata is unavailable.

cases.teaching_note: The source commit is established, while the signer remains unestablished without conflicting evidence.

cases.claim_text: Schema drift added two columns and caused parser warnings.

visible_evidence.excerpt: The observed schema contains two columns absent from the reference schema; parser logs were not retained.

cases.teaching_note: The two added columns are established, while parser warnings and their cause remain unestablished.

cases.claim_text: The controlled cache eviction reduced the error rate and restored p95 latency.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Cache eviction was the only intervention; error rate fell from 5.0 to 1.0 percent. No latency measurement was recorded.

cases.teaching_note: The bounded intervention supports the error-rate effect, while latency restoration remains unmeasured.

cases.claim_text: The incident affected the API and the worker queue for 25 minutes.

visible_evidence.excerpt: The API exceeded its degradation threshold continuously for 25 minutes; worker-queue telemetry is unavailable.

cases.teaching_note: The API impact and duration are established, while worker-queue impact remains unestablished.

cases.claim_text: The downloaded model artifact exactly matches the registered artifact bytes.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Registered SHA-256=8abc; downloaded SHA-256=8abc; both digests cover the complete file bytes.

cases.teaching_note: Matching complete-file digests establish byte identity for the two artifacts.

cases.claim_text: Rolling back configuration revision 17 restored the error rate to its registered baseline.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Registered baseline error rate=0.4 percent; pre-rollback rate=6.2 percent; post-rollback rate=0.4 percent; no other intervention occurred.

cases.teaching_note: The isolated rollback and matching post-intervention baseline establish the complete bounded claim.

cases.claim_text: The executed preprocessing path used median imputation for the age column.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Executed step=median_imputer; fitted column=age; trace status=completed; execution hash matches the run manifest.

cases.teaching_note: The bound execution trace establishes the method, column, and executed status.

cases.claim_text: The complete evaluation dataset contains exactly 27 duplicate rows.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Complete-dataset duplicate audit: row_count=6,000; duplicate_row_count=27; rows_scanned=6,000.

cases.teaching_note: The complete census establishes both the exact duplicate count and its dataset scope.

cases.claim_text: Incident-window p99 latency exceeded the registered 750 millisecond threshold.

visible_evidence.excerpt: Registered incident p99 threshold=750 ms; measured incident-window p99=903 ms.

cases.teaching_note: The registered threshold and measured value establish the metric, window, and exceedance.
